description.en: Peak/valley electricity meter for the DSH composer: a minimal balance chip with a hover 24h peak/valley timeline, 5s official balance refresh, and independent spend metering. Adapted for DSH 0.2.
description.zh: DSH 输入框上方的峰谷电表：极简余额徽章 + 悬停 24 小时峰谷时间轴，官方余额 5 秒刷新，今日消耗独立计费。已适配 DSH 0.2。

description.en: A minimal balance chip above the composer. Hover it for a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange peak, blue valley) with a live marker, official balance refreshed every 5s, and today's spend metered from llm/stream. Handles the official weekend all-off-peak rule (since 2026-08-23) in both the timeline and billing; 10 color presets plus custom peak/valley colors.
description.zh: 输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章；悬停浮现 24 小时峰谷时间轴（峰橙/谷蓝 + 当前时刻指针），官方余额 5 秒刷新，今日消耗由 llm/stream 独立计费。时间轴与计费都遵循官方周末全天低谷规则（2026-08-23 起）；内置 10 套配色并支持自定义峰/谷色。
